title: Generic Mimikatz String Detection
code:
rule Generic_Mimikatz_Strings
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects common strings found in Mimikatz credential-dumping tool builds"
        author = "cyber-cheat-sheet"
        reference = "Public Mimikatz string signatures"
        level = "high"

    strings:
        $s1 = "sekurlsa::logonpasswords" ascii
        $s2 = "mimikatz(commandline)" ascii wide
        $s3 = "gentilkiwi" ascii
        $s4 = "Benjamin DELPY" ascii

    condition:
        any of them
}
description: Flags binaries containing well-known Mimikatz internal strings, useful for scanning file shares or endpoint quarantine for the tool.

title: Suspicious PowerShell Encoded Command in File
code:
rule Suspicious_PowerShell_EncodedCommand
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects files containing PowerShell -EncodedCommand invocations, often seen in dropper scripts"
        level = "medium"

    strings:
        $enc1 = "-EncodedCommand" ascii wide nocase
        $enc2 = "-enc " ascii wide nocase
        $enc3 = "FromBase64String" ascii wide

    condition:
        2 of them
}
description: Scans script/batch files for markers of base64-encoded PowerShell payloads commonly used by droppers and loaders.

title: Generic Ransomware Note Detection
code:
rule Generic_Ransomware_Note
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects text commonly found in ransomware ransom-note files dropped after encryption"
        level = "high"

    strings:
        $s1 = "your files have been encrypted" nocase ascii wide
        $s2 = "decrypt" nocase ascii wide
        $s3 = "bitcoin" nocase ascii wide
        $s4 = "do not rename" nocase ascii wide

    condition:
        3 of them
}
description: Matches ransom-note style text files, useful for triage sweeps across a file share after a suspected ransomware event.

title: PE File with Suspiciously Small Number of Imports
code:
rule Suspicious_PE_LowImportCount
{
    meta:
        description = "Flags PE executables with an unusually small import table, sometimes indicating a packed or shellcode-loader binary"
        level = "low"

    condition:
        pe.is_pe and
        pe.number_of_imports > 0 and
        pe.number_of_imports < 3
}
description: Uses the YARA pe module to flag PE files with very few imported functions, a weak but useful packing/loader heuristic to combine with other signals.

title: UPX Packed Executable
code:
rule UPX_Packed_Executable
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects executables packed with the UPX packer via its distinctive section names"
        level = "info"

    strings:
        $upx1 = "UPX0" ascii
        $upx2 = "UPX1" ascii
        $upx3 = "UPX!" ascii

    condition:
        2 of them
}
description: Identifies UPX-packed binaries by their characteristic section names — packing alone isn't malicious but often warrants closer inspection.

title: Suspicious PHP Web Shell (eval/base64)
code:
rule Suspicious_PHP_WebShell
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects common PHP web-shell patterns combining eval with base64/gzinflate decoding"
        level = "high"

    strings:
        $eval = "eval(" ascii
        $b64 = "base64_decode(" ascii
        $gz = "gzinflate(" ascii
        $post = "$_POST[" ascii
        $req = "$_REQUEST[" ascii

    condition:
        $eval and (( $b64 or $gz ) and ( $post or $req ))
}
description: Flags PHP files combining eval() with base64/gzip decoding of request parameters — a very common obfuscated web-shell pattern.

title: Office Document with AutoOpen Macro
code:
rule Office_AutoOpen_Macro
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects OLE/Office documents containing an AutoOpen macro, commonly abused for phishing payload execution"
        level = "medium"

    strings:
        $auto1 = "AutoOpen" ascii wide
        $auto2 = "Document_Open" ascii wide
        $shell = "Shell(" ascii wide

    condition:
        1 of ($auto*) and $shell
}
description: Flags Office documents that both auto-execute on open and call Shell() — a strong phishing-macro indicator worth quarantining for analysis.

title: Cobalt Strike Beacon Config Marker
code:
rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Marker
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects a byte sequence commonly associated with Cobalt Strike's default beacon configuration XOR key"
        level = "high"

    strings:
        $s1 = { 00 01 00 01 00 02 } // known config block pattern fragment (illustrative)
        $s2 = "beacon.dll" ascii nocase
        $s3 = "ReflectiveLoader" ascii

    condition:
        any of them
}
description: Illustrative signature for spotting common Cobalt Strike beacon artifacts; production detection should use maintained community rule sets, updated as the tool evolves.

title: Suspicious Double File Extension
code:
rule Suspicious_Double_Extension_Filename
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects filenames using a double extension trick (e.g. invoice.pdf.exe) commonly used in phishing attachments"
        level = "medium"

    strings:
        $ext1 = ".pdf.exe" nocase ascii wide
        $ext2 = ".doc.exe" nocase ascii wide
        $ext3 = ".xls.exe" nocase ascii wide
        $ext4 = ".jpg.exe" nocase ascii wide

    condition:
        any of them
}
description: Matches on filenames using the classic double-extension disguise, useful when scanning email attachment metadata or a downloads folder.

title: Generic Reverse Shell String Indicators
code:
rule Generic_Reverse_Shell_Strings
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects common strings associated with scripted reverse shells (bash/python/perl one-liners)"
        level = "medium"

    strings:
        $s1 = "/bin/sh -i" ascii
        $s2 = "socket.socket(socket.AF_INET" ascii
        $s3 = "os.dup2(" ascii
        $s4 = "/dev/tcp/" ascii

    condition:
        2 of them
}
description: Flags scripts containing common reverse-shell scaffolding strings — a useful, low-cost triage signature for dropped shell scripts.
